title: Add provision-to-ready step breakdown dashboard (timings + failure rates)
creator: Miles Thornton
project: Provision-to-ready automation sprint (Dedicated Capacity & Fleet Management)
description:
Problem
We need operator-grade visibility into the provision-to-ready pipeline so Infra/SRE can quickly answer:
- Where are we spending time (per step) on the Allocated -> Provisioning -> Validating -> Ready path?
- What are the top failure modes, and how do they vary by region / GPU type / image channel?
- Are we improving time-to-ready P50/P95 as rollout expands, without paging ourselves due to metric cardinality?

Scope
Create a Grafana dashboard (and any supporting recording rules) that breaks down:
1) Per-step latency distributions (P50/P95/P99) for provisioning + validation steps
2) Failure rates by step + coarse failure reason
3) Quarantine counts + rate of quarantine transitions (as a safety signal)
4) Retries/backoff impact (where the pipeline is spending time due to retries)

Data sources / metrics assumptions
- Primary source: Prometheus metrics emitted by provisioning orchestrator + validation agent + readiness service.
- Secondary source: tracing (Tempo) for per-request/per-node deep dives (linked from dashboard, but not required for all panels).

Metric naming + tagging (cardinality constraints)
Hard requirements (per Allison/Obs standards):
- NO per-node identifiers (node_id, instance_id, hostname) in Prometheus metric labels.
- Failure_reason must be coarse + bounded. If we need details, store them as logs/artifacts in readiness service and link to them.
- Allowed high-level dimensions for dashboards:
  - region
  - gpu_type (A100/H100/L4 etc.)
  - pool_type (dedicated/shared)
  - image_channel (candidate/stable)
  - step (bounded enum)
  - outcome (success|failure|timeout)
  - state (Allocated|Provisioning|Validating|Ready|Quarantined)
- Time window defaults: 6h / 24h / 7d; ensure panels still render under 7d without exploding query cost.

Dashboard requirements (panels)
A. Overview
- Time-to-ready (end-to-end) P50/P95 (by region, by gpu_type)
- Provision-to-ready success rate (Ready within X minutes) and overall failure rate
- Current counts by readiness state (Ready/Validating/Provisioning/Quarantined)

B. Step breakdown
- Per-step duration P50/P95 (stacked or table) with filters: region, gpu_type, pool_type, image_channel
- Step duration heatmap (optional) for one selected step (e.g., "kubelet_join" or "nccl_smoke")

C. Failures
- Failure rate by step (top N)
- Failure rate by region x gpu_type (heatmap)
- Top failure reasons for a selected step (bounded labels only)

D. Quarantine + retries
- Quarantine transitions over time + current quarantine population
- Retries per step and retry-induced latency (where available)

E. Drill-down links
- Link-outs to:
  - Fleet readiness service per-pool view (internal)
  - Runbook: Provision-to-ready failures triage
  - Tempo trace search (filtered by step + region + pool_type)

Retention + performance
- Ensure queries use recording rules where needed (e.g., pre-aggregated histograms per step/region/gpu_type).
- Avoid unbounded label joins.
- Confirm dashboard is usable with 30d retention (and doesn’t require per-minute raw cardinality at 30d).

Acceptance criteria
- Dashboard exists in Grafana under folder: "Fleet / Provision-to-ready" and is discoverable via search.
- Default view answers: "what step is slow" + "what step is failing" without switching dashboards.
- All panels render under 10s for a 24h window in prod.
- Observability sign-off on label set + cardinality.
- Dashboard includes links to runbook + readiness service.

Out of scope
- Paging alerts (covered by ENG-4821 + separate alert tuning notes); we can include a placeholder panel / annotation for alert thresholds.
- Per-node investigation UI (that lives in readiness service / internal console).

References
- Confluence: Provision-to-ready dashboards catalog (target doc)
- Drive: Provisioning step tracing plan (span names, tag constraints)
- Related implementation PRs:
  - Metrics emission: redwood/pr-18441
  - Dashboards + alert rules: observability-pack/pr-812
  - Cardinality follow-up (if needed): redwood/pr-18475
